title: Turbo Apex: 2D Racing
description: High-octane 2D arcade racing. Dodge traffic, grab nitro power-ups, earn coins and unlock new cars in the garage.
howToPlay: Steer your car through traffic, collect coins and nitro, and survive as long as you can. Your best score and garage progress are saved on your device.
controls: Arrow keys or A/D to steer on desktop. On phones use the on-screen controls or tilt your device.

title: Eco-Rogue: Shift & Survive
description: A tactical puzzle-roguelike on a 5×5 board. Slide rows and columns to craft, fight monsters, trigger combos and survive.
howToPlay: Swipe or drag rows and columns to shift tiles. Match resources to craft, line up attacks against enemies and pick perks between rounds.
controls: Swipe with a finger on mobile; click and drag with the mouse on desktop.
